html:
Hello EOMasters!

I teased it already a few weeks ago — big changes are coming to the EOMasters Toolboxes. With the release of version 2.0, there is now only one toolbox.

The previous separation is gone. Everything is unified into a single toolbox, and all former Pro features are now free for everyone.

To all users who supported me and the development by purchasing the Pro version: thank you. Your support has meant a lot to me, and I’m genuinely grateful.

Let’s take a look at what you now get for free when you install the EOMasters Toolbox into SNAP:

  • Quick Menu — Fast access to frequently used SNAP actions.

  • Loop GPT — Run multiple processing commands in one step.

  • Band Maths Extensions — Additional functions for advanced raster calculations.

  • Wavelength Editor — Edit wavelength properties across compatible products.

  • Asset Library — Save and reuse sites, geometries, masks, and expressions.

  • SpeX — Calculate more than 270 predefined or custom spectral indices.

  • PyEditor and SnapKit — Write and run Python scripts directly in SNAP.

  • Coastal Map — Add land, water, coastline, tidal-flat, and proximity information.

  • Cyanobacteria Index — Detect potential cyanobacteria blooms in water bodies.

  • Sentinel-2 Geometry Upscaling — Create detailed sun and viewing-angle bands.

  • Sentinel-2 Super-Resolution — Enhance 10 m and 20 m bands to 5 m resolution.

  • Surface Reflectance Normalisation — Improve comparisons between Sentinel-2 observations.

  • 620 nm Band Estimation — Generate a band for water-quality analysis.

  • Improved Sentinel-2 L2A Reader — Correct the B1 detector-footprint issue.

  • ASTER and EMIT Readers — Open ASTER L1T and EMIT L1B/L2A products.

  • and more

What’s next?

I’m not entirely sure yet. New features? Possibly — if I see something worth implementing or if users request it. But development will slow down for now, because I’ve started new adventures. Actually more than one.

So this is not the end — it’s the beginning of something new.

Stay tuned if you want to learn more.

Goodbye & Tschüss Marco
